title: Freddie Mac MBS Disclosure Intelligence
summary: A public MBS disclosure decision product with exact source reconciliation, 38 released metric contracts, evidence-backed investigations, and a complete digest-verified data release.
outcome: Delivered a public trust-to-investigation workflow over 693,640,933 physical disclosure records, 264,922,553 loan-period facts, 9,240,038 security-period facts, and all 167 approved source and derived release artifacts.

deployment.runtime: Static product with immutable downloadable source and derived data assets

metrics: 693,640,933 physical records reconciled with zero rejected, duplicate, or quarantined rows
38 of 38 supported metric contracts released with 1,816 parity and 1,068 formula checks passing
167 of 167 approved source and derived artifacts matched remotely by size and SHA-256 digest
45,675,556,283 bytes published in the immutable data-v1 release
stages: Validate 125 source archives across exact package, member, schema, and reporting-window contracts
Reconcile every physical record into an explicit governed disposition
Build correction-aware security facts and compressed loan-period partitions
Calculate and independently verify only versioned source-backed measures
Connect the verified release to the decision product, investigation workflow, and semantic API
Publish the static product and every approved source and derived artifact with exact integrity verification
architecture: Official archives pass package, member, schema, period, duplicate, and reconciliation controls before downstream use.
Correction-aware SQLite security facts and compressed loan-period partitions preserve native grain and provenance.
A versioned metric engine emits components and formulas only for 38 approved source-backed contracts.
The browser product, investigation workflow, and semantic API consume one governed product contract.
GitHub Pages serves the decision workflow while GitHub Releases distributes all approved row-level source and derived artifacts outside Git history.
evaluation: All 693,640,933 physical records reconcile with zero rejected, duplicate, or quarantined records.
All 38 supported contracts reconcile through 1,816 segment, weighted, and transition checks plus 1,068 formula checks.
The product passes analytics, accessibility-state, responsive-layout, investigation, API authorization, and static smoke checks.
The M11 Azure candidate passed identity, recovery, telemetry, load, rollback, cost, and teardown checks before removal.
The M12 publisher verified all remote release assets before publication and repeated anonymous verification afterward.
operationalTradeoffs: SQLite and compressed partitions preserve exact detail with bounded memory and no recurring warehouse cost, but processing is batch-oriented.
The static product removes request-time compute and mutation exposure, while bulk review uses downloadable release assets instead of arbitrary public queries.
GitHub Releases supports the measured data volume, but flattened asset names depend on the manifest for path restoration.
The cited assistant remains disabled publicly because M10 proves a bounded contract, not a general conversational service.
Power BI remains parked because it is optional to the delivered provider-neutral workflow.
disclaimer: This public disclosure analytics project supports descriptive release operations and MBS investigation. It does not make borrower, investment, valuation, trading, hedging, causal, or production-availability claims. Source materials remain attributable to Freddie Mac and subject to applicable provider terms.

presentation.question: Can an MBS disclosure release be trusted, what changed, and what evidence should be investigated next?
presentation.answer: The product starts with exact source disposition and schema evidence, then connects certified metrics to correction-aware cohort and concentration views and immutable investigation context.
presentation.decisionSupported: Determine whether a disclosure release is usable and assign an evidence-backed investigation without unsupported financial inference.
presentation.evaluationMode: Complete acquired-population reconciliation, independent metric recomputation, hosted release-candidate checks, and exact public asset verification.
presentation.publicationStatus: Live public product and complete approved row-level source and derived data release.
presentation.licenseNote: Repository code is licensed separately; published source materials remain attributable to Freddie Mac and subject to applicable provider terms.
presentation.coverAlt: Freddie Mac MBS disclosure dashboard showing portfolio and credit investigation views

story.recruiterSummary: This product answers the first disclosure question: can the release be trusted? It reconciles every source record, exposes only supported measures, connects movements to evidence, and publishes the complete approved data release.
story.technicalNarrative: Exact contracts validate packages, members, schema eras, periods, and duplicates. SQLite stores correction-aware security facts while compressed partitions preserve 264.9 million loan-period facts. A versioned engine emits 38 supported contracts. The browser and semantic API share one governed payload, and investigations preserve immutable evidence context. GitHub Pages serves the interface while GitHub Releases distributes all 167 approved source and derived artifacts under a verified manifest.
scalabilityRoadmap: Retain compressed partitions and bounded-memory streaming while measured refresh and verification targets pass.
Add a hosted query plane only when a measured concurrency or latency requirement justifies recurring infrastructure.
Reopen Power BI only when a Windows runtime can produce engine evidence against the same contracts.
Add metrics only with explicit source, methodology, denominator, timing, correction, and golden-case evidence.
story.executiveSummary: The release turns a large Freddie Mac disclosure corpus into an auditable trust-to-investigation workflow. It covers 693.6 million physical records, releases every supported contract, and preserves complete row-level source and derived data in a verified 45.7 GB release.
story.intendedUser: An MBS disclosure operations analyst, market-data analyst, capital-markets reviewer, or hiring manager.

example.title: Investigate a disclosure movement without losing source trust
steps: Confirm source completeness, schema validity, exclusions, and correction status
Review the material movement and its governed metric definition
Compare correction views, cohorts, credit segments, geography, seller, and servicer concentration
Open provenance and limitations behind the selected movement
Create an investigation with immutable release, filter, and evidence context

technologyDecisions.rationale: Preserves exact detail and correction lineage across hundreds of millions of records with bounded memory.
technologyDecisions.alternative: Provision a managed warehouse before measuring need.
technologyDecisions.tradeoff: Processing is batch-oriented and offers no shared arbitrary-query concurrency.

technologyDecisions.rationale: The public workflow needs no request-time database, credential, mutation surface, or recurring compute.
technologyDecisions.alternative: Expose the semantic API as a permanent public service.
technologyDecisions.tradeoff: Public users receive governed views and data downloads rather than arbitrary queries.

technologyDecisions.technology: GitHub Releases for complete data publication
technologyDecisions.rationale: The measured asset set fits provider limits and keeps immutable data beside source, documentation, and workflow evidence.
technologyDecisions.alternative: Commit data to Git, publish only summaries, or add another dataset provider.
technologyDecisions.tradeoff: Flattened asset names require the manifest to restore logical paths.
